reads.sell: An off-dry Alsace Gewurztraminer, heady with lychee, rose petal and ginger, rich and silky with just a kiss of sweetness. It is the wine for spice: Thai or Creole dishes, foie gras or a pungent washed rind cheese.

why.grape: Lychee and rose petal with ginger and allspice, an oily, faintly bitter texture and low acid: nothing else smells like Gewurztraminer.
why.climate: Alsace is cool and dry behind the Vosges: the low acid and high alcohol belong to the grape, while fresh rather than baked fruit and a clean finish keep the call cool.
